description: This file defines the 'Regex' class providing static methods for regular expression operations such as match, matchAll, replace, and their variants, utilizing the 'Preg' class internally. It is part of the 'composer/pcre' package within the 'composer' namespace.

classes.name: Regex
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for regular expression matching and replacement, wrapping the internal 'Preg' class and returning specialized result objects.

methods.name: isMatch
methods.description: Checks if the pattern matches the subject string starting at a given offset.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs a regular expression match, returning a MatchResult object.

methods.name: matchStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs a strict match that throws if null groups are encountered, returning MatchStrictGroupsResult.

methods.name: matchWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs a match with offset information, returning MatchWithOffsetsResult.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Performs a global regex match, returning MatchAllResult.

methods.name: matchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs a strict global match with group validation, returning MatchAllStrictGroupsResult.

methods.name: matchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs a global match with offset info, returning MatchAllWithOffsetsResult.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs a regex replacement, returning the result and count.

methods.name: replaceCallback
methods.description: Performs a regex replacement with a replacement callback, returning the result and count.

methods.name: replaceCallbackStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs a strict replacement with a callback, throwing if null groups are encountered.

methods.name: replaceCallbackArray
methods.description: Performs multiple callback replacements specified in an array.
